card.essence: Carbo vegetabilis addresses states of profound collapse and imperfect oxidation, where vital force is nearly exhausted. The patient presents with cold, blue extremities yet craves air and fanning; blood stagnates in capillaries causing cyanosis, passive oozing haemorrhages, and decomposition. Weakness follows exhausting disease, drugging, or loss of vital fluids; even the simplest food disagrees and everything turns to flatulence. This remedy revives patients from the very jaws of death when coldness, sepsis, and air hunger dominate.

keynotes.text: Vital force exhausted; icy cold surface, yet craves air and must be fanned hard
Blood stagnates in capillaries; blueness, coldness, ecchymosis; venous turgescence
Everything turns to gas; excessive flatulence in stomach and abdomen
Passive haemorrhage from any mucous surface; dark, oozing, decomposed blood
Hippocratic face; pale, grayish-yellow, cold with cold sweat
Never recovered from exhausting effects of previous illness, injury, or drugging
Cold knees at night; icy coldness of extremities, breath, tongue
Eructations give temporary relief; belchings rancid, loud

modalities_worse.text: Butter, pork, fat food; rich food
Tight clothing around waist and abdomen
Exhausting diseases, depletions, loss of vital fluids

mentals: Aversion to darkness; fear of ghosts
Sudden loss of memory; weakness of memory and slowness of thought
Mental operations slow; stupid, lazy, sluggish; cannot rouse to activity
Wants to lie down and doze
physicals: Varicose veins; veins distended, lazy, paralysed; vaso-motor paralysis
Burning sensations internally with external coldness
Looseness of teeth, easily bleeding gums; pyorrhoea
Epistaxis in daily attacks for weeks, worse from exertion; face pale before and after
Hoarseness in evenings, damp evening air; fails when voice exerted
Frequent involuntary cadaverous-smelling stools, followed by burning
Cold breath, cold tongue; body becomes blue, icy-cold
Mucous membranes break down, become spongy, bleed, ulcerate and become putrid
Hair falls off easily; scalp itches when warm in bed
Head feels heavy, constricted; hat like a heavy weight
clinical: Collapse in cholera, typhoid, or terminal stages of disease with cold sweat, cold breath, voice lost
Neglected pneumonia, especially in old alcoholics; threatened paralysis from inability to expectorate
Asthma dating from childhood measles or whooping cough; senile asthma
Indigestion from a drunken debauch; dyspepsia of nursing women with excessive flatulence
Cachexia in old persons or those whose vitality weakened by disease
Septic states; gangrene; putrid ulceration with decomposition
Weak digestion; simplest food disagrees; all food turns to gas
Burning, bluish piles; white haemorrhoids with excoriation
Destructive lung diseases with copious expectoration and decomposition

differentials.note: Both have flatulence and debility from fluid loss; Carbo has coldness, air hunger, and fanning desire; China has bloating without relief from eructation
Both in threatened paralysis from inability to expectorate; Ant-t has rattling mucus, drowsiness; Carbo has icy coldness and air hunger
Both have easily bleeding ulcers and passive haemorrhage; Phos more active bleeding, desires cold drinks which are vomited when warm
Both affected by fat food and pastry; Puls weeps, wants sympathy, thirstless; Carbo has flatulence, coldness, craves air
Both show lack of reaction and want of susceptibility to remedies; Opium has stupor, painlessness; Carbo has air hunger and coldness
Both have venous stasis; Sulph hot patient, burning feet wants them uncovered; Carbo icy cold, wants fanning

cautions: Want of susceptibility to well-selected remedies may indicate Carbo veg (or Opium, Valeriana)
Carbo animalis and Carbo veg do not follow each other well; they are inimical
